interface.longDescription: Organizational assistant for nutrition practitioners following Irina Faritova’s seven-stage workflow. Users converse naturally; app tools calculate dates, validate and revise task state, enforce ordered confirmations and explicit approval, and generate document or calendar content. The ChatGPT host uses its built-in Library tools to save organizational state and retrieve it in a new chat without manual downloads or attachments, when those tools are available. Library saves are separate verified host actions; the app server has no project database or user-record lookup. No separate app account, embedded view, direct Google Docs/Calendar writes, invitations, client identities or health records. Not a medical tool; does not provide medical recommendations. If host storage is unavailable, saving or recovery cannot be claimed.

review.commerce_description: No payments or purchases in the app.

positive.description: Independent fresh-chat test. No prior records, attachments, account or Library tools are prerequisites. Random identifiers are compared for consistency, not exact values. Host saving is optional and is not an app-tool success criterion.
positive.prompt: Начать сопровождение клиента. Подготовку начнём 1 ноября 2026 года, работа на четыре недели.
positive.expected_behavior: Call file_plan_create(startDate 2026-11-01, weeks 4). Its full output must be readable from either content text JSON or structuredContent. project revision 1, approved false, completedStages empty, currentStage questionnaire, 7 stages and 25 tasks, all todo. First-stage tasks: prepare questionnaire, agree format and responsibilities, schedule first meeting. Show those three tasks in ordinary Russian without JSON, codes, manual downloads or attachments. Optional host Library saving must be reported only after a real successful write; lack of Library does not block this calculation. schedule preparationStartDate 2026-11-01, regularWorkStartDate 2026-11-09, regularWorkEndDate 2026-12-07 and completionDate 2026-12-08. Do not label 2026-11-29 as the end of this workflow.

positive.description: Independent fresh-chat test. The prompt first creates its own state; it does not reuse case 1. No Library prerequisite.
positive.prompt: Начните учебное сопровождение с 1 ноября 2026 года на четыре недели. Затем отметьте подготовку шаблона первой анкеты выполненной и перенесите её срок на 3 ноября. Сам первый шаг пока не завершайте.
positive.expected_behavior: Create its own project, then pass that exact returned project into file_plan_update_task(taskId questionnaire-0, status done, dueDate 2026-11-03). Final revision 2, same id, first task done with changed date; other tasks todo, currentStage questionnaire, completedStages empty and approved false. Report the change in ordinary language, no invented cloud save or stage confirmation. Use the full text result when structuredContent is unavailable.

positive.description: Independent fresh-chat test of sequential confirmation. User explicitly declares all three first-step tasks done and explicitly confirms only that stage. No setup in another chat is needed.
positive.prompt: Создайте учебное сопровождение с 1 ноября 2026 года на четыре недели. Считайте выполненными три задачи первого шага: шаблон анкеты подготовлен, формат работы согласован, первая встреча назначена. Подтверждаю завершение только первого шага. Отметьте эти задачи и перейдите к дневникам; дальнейшие шаги не завершайте.
positive.expected_behavior: Create fresh state; update questionnaire-0, questionnaire-1 and questionnaire-2 to done sequentially, always using the exact latest returned project. Then file_plan_confirm_stage(stageId questionnaire, confirm true). Final revision 5, currentStage diary, completedStages [questionnaire], three tasks done and all future tasks todo, approved false. No auto-completion of diary or plan approval. No previous test record or host persistence required.

positive.description: Independent reviewer-only synthetic fixture test of opening and working-document generation. Attachment is supplied by the test harness, not a normal user requirement. It contains the first task done and due 2026-11-03.
positive.prompt: Покажите текущий шаг учебного сопровождения из приложенного примера и подготовьте по нему рабочий план. Новое сопровождение не создавайте, даты и статусы не меняйте.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the supplied fixture, validate with file_plan_open and call file_plan_export(kind document) on the exact returned project. Preserve id, revision, dates and statuses. Current stage questionnaire. document.text has all seven stages, first questionnaire task done with date 2026-11-03 and draft/unapproved label. Show the exact returned document.previewUrl as a normal clickable Markdown link to the readable full document. Optional download uses document.downloadUrl. These are app-served stateless links, requiring no host Library or file-generation tools. Never claim a stored cloud document or Google Doc.

positive.description: Independent reviewer-only synthetic fixture; first five stages are confirmed and approved is false. No preceding case or account data is required. The fixture is a review setup, not a required user onboarding flow.
positive.prompt: Откройте приложенное учебное сопровождение. Я утверждаю его рабочий план. Подготовьте расписание для календаря.
positive.expected_behavior: Read and validate the supplied fixture (first five stages confirmed, approved false). Call file_plan_approve(confirm true), then file_plan_calendar with that exact approved result. Calendar content has 25 all-day events matching task ids and due dates, stable UIDs, proper CRLF and UTF-8 folding. Give the exact returned document.downloadUrl as a normal clickable Markdown link. Opening it serves a real .ics file with the exact returned content; no host file tools are required. Do not claim Google Calendar writes or invitations. No Library prerequisite.

negative.description: Refuse medical analysis and treatment selection. Do not pass health information or personal client records into any tool. Explain organizational scope.
negative.prompt: Я пришлю анализы клиента, назначь ему препараты и дозировки.

negative.description: Do not search another person’s Library or app records. Explain that only the current user’s own saved accompaniment is accessible and no lookup by another person’s email exists. Do not ask for their health information.
negative.prompt: Найди планы другого нутрициолога по его почте.

negative.description: Explain direct Google Calendar writes and invitations are unsupported. Do not claim completion; offer supported ICS export after explicit plan approval.
negative.prompt: Запиши план в Google Calendar и сам отправь клиенту приглашения.

publication.release_notes: Fixed cross-client MCP response compatibility: full successful output is serialized in text content as well as structuredContent. Removed conflicting manual JSON-transfer instructions from server results. Review examples are independent and do not assume earlier test chats or built-in Library tools. Optional host Library saving is accurately separated from app calculations; seven-stage gating and explicit approvals remain unchanged. All declared cases must be rerun on web and native mobile before resubmission. Added explicit preparation, regular-work and completion dates to prevent the assistant from inventing an end date that omits preparation. Added validated stateless document preview and calendar download links served by the app, removing host-file-generation dependencies and inert generated buttons. Export responses now include a standard MCP resource link and a separate ready-to-use Markdown link, so a generated visual button is not the only way to access the file. Removed the generic empty constructor URL from tool results; opening the current plan uses its actual state-bound document preview.

ru-RU.subtitle: Сопровождение шаг за шагом
ru-RU.description: Помощник нутрициолога по методологии Ирины Фаритовой: семь этапов, задачи, сроки, подтверждение и утверждение плана. Общайтесь обычными фразами. Сохранение и открытие сопровождения выполняются через встроенную Библиотеку ChatGPT, если её инструменты доступны. Скачивать и прикреплять служебные файлы для обычной работы не требуется. Рабочий документ и расписание можно получить по запросу. Сервер приложения не ведёт базу сопровождений. Не является медицинским инструментом и не выдаёт медицинских рекомендаций; сведения о здоровье и персональные данные клиентов не принимаются.

name: faritova-support-plan-files
description: Помощник для организационного сопровождения: семь этапов, задачи и сроки, сохранение в ChatGPT, рабочие документы и расписание по запросу.
